name: Indonesia Business Agent Suite
description: Full Indonesian business reasoning capability bundle for AI agents — spanning Legal, Tax, HR, Finance, Marketing, and Strategy with 88 agent skills, 55 deterministic engines, and shared auditable provenance.
tagline: One ecosystem. Six business domains. 88 agent capabilities.

plugins.name: Legal Intelligence
plugins.description: Indonesian contract review, PDP compliance, KBLI/OSS navigator, trademark, NDA, SPK, legal memo, somasi, compliance risk.

plugins.name: Tax Intelligence
plugins.description: PPh 21 TER, PPh 21 gross-up, PPh 23/26, PPh Badan, PPn/PPnBM, UMKM final tax, transfer pricing, e-Faktur, tax audit prep, tax planning, optimization, risk analysis, cross-border, regulatory diff, regulatory impact, PSAK reporting.

plugins.name: HR Intelligence
plugins.description: BPJS calculator, THR, PHK severance, PHK advanced matrix, PKWT/PKWTT compliance, wage structure, surat peringatan, interview, SOP, BPJS admin, SPT tahunan.

plugins.name: Finance Intelligence
plugins.description: Break-even analysis, financial ratio, cash flow, capital budgeting, working capital, unit economics, financial modeling, financial statements, accounting basics, budgeting/forecasting, cost accounting, business feasibility, business scenario, decision engine, VC term sheet waterfall.

plugins.name: Marketing Intelligence
plugins.description: Market sizing, margin pricing, product classification, competitor analysis, customer segmentation, JTBD, voice of customer, positioning, go-to-market, SEO (Shopee/Tokopedia/GMB), content (TikTok, IG, YouTube, WhatsApp, LinkedIn), KOL brief, buyer negotiator, customer support, logistics claim.

plugins.name: Strategic Intelligence
plugins.description: BCG matrix, Porter five forces, Porter three tests, Ansoff matrix, VRIO analysis, value chain analysis, scenario planning, strategic planning, decision making, strategic risk analysis.

installation.npm: npm install adamriofc/indonesia-business-agent-skills (Git-based; npm registry publish pending)
